record.bible_text: Send<WH07971><WTH8798> ye the lamb<WH03733> to the ruler<WH04910><WTH8802> of the land<WH0776> from Sela<WH05554> to the wilderness<WH04057>, unto the mount<WH02022> of the daughter<WH01323> of Zion<WH06726>. <RF>Sela: or, Petra: Heb. A rock<Rf>

For it shall be, <FI>that<Fi> , as a wandering<WH05074><WTH8802> bird<WH05775> cast out<WH07971><WTH8794> of the nest<WH07064>, <FI>so<Fi> the daughters<WH01323> of Moab<WH04124> shall be at the fords<WH04569> of Arnon<WH0769>. <RF>cast...: or, a nest forsaken<Rf>

Take<WH0935><WTH8685> counsel<WH06098>, execute<WH06213><WTH8798> judgment<WH06415>; make<WH07896><WTH8798> thy shadow<WH06738> as the night<WH03915> in the midst<WH08432> of the noonday<WH06672>; hide<WH05641><WTH8761> the outcasts<WH05080><WTH8737>; bewray<WH01540><WTH8762> not him that wandereth<WH05074><WTH8802>. <RF>Take: Heb. Bring<Rf>

Let mine outcasts<WH05080><WTH8737> dwell<WH01481><WTH8799> with thee, Moab<WH04124>; be<WH01933><WTH8798> thou a covert<WH05643> to them from the face<WH06440> of the spoiler<WH07703><WTH8802>: for the extortioner<WH04160><WTH8801> is at an end<WH0656><WTH8804>, the spoiler<WH07701> ceaseth<WH03615><WTH8804>, the oppressors<WH07429><WTH8802> are consumed<WH08552><WTH8804> out of the land<WH0776>. <RF>extortioner: Heb. wringer<Rf> <RF>the oppressors: Heb. the treaders down<Rf>

And in mercy<WH02617> shall the throne<WH03678> be established<WH03559><WTH8717>: and he shall sit<WH03427><WTH8804> upon it in truth<WH0571> in the tabernacle<WH0168> of David<WH01732>, judging<WH08199><WTH8802>, and seeking<WH01875><WTH8802> judgment<WH04941>, and hasting<WH04106> righteousness<WH06664>. <RF>established: or, prepared<Rf><CM>

We have heard<WH08085><WTH8804> of the pride<WH01347> of Moab<WH04124>; <FI>he is<Fi> very<WH03966> proud<WH01341>: <FI>even<Fi> of his haughtiness<WH01346>, and his pride<WH01347>, and his wrath<WH05678>: <FI>but<Fi> his lies<WH0907> <FI>shall<Fi>  not <FI>be<Fi> so.

Therefore shall Moab<WH04124> howl<WH03213><WTH8686> for Moab<WH04124>, every one shall howl<WH03213><WTH8686>: for the foundations<WH0808> of Kirhareseth<WH07025> shall ye mourn<WH01897><WTH8799>; surely <FI>they are<Fi> stricken<WH05218>. <RF>mourn: or, mutter<Rf>

For the fields<WH07709> of Heshbon<WH02809> languish<WH0535><WTH8797>, <FI>and<Fi> the vine<WH01612> of Sibmah<WH07643>: the lords<WH01167> of the heathen<WH01471> have broken down<WH01986><WTH8804> the principal plants<WH08291> thereof, they are come<WH05060><WTH8804> <FI>even<Fi> unto Jazer<WH03270>, they wandered<WH08582><WTH8804> <FI>through<Fi> the wilderness<WH04057>: her branches<WH07976> are stretched out<WH05203><WTH8738>, they are gone over<WH05674><WTH8804> the sea<WH03220>. <RF>stretched...: or, plucked up<Rf>

Therefore I will bewail<WH01058><WTH8799> with the weeping<WH01065> of Jazer<WH03270> the vine<WH01612> of Sibmah<WH07643>: I will water<WH07301><WTH8762> thee with my tears<WH01832>, O Heshbon<WH02809>, and Elealeh<WH0500>: for the shouting<WH01959> for thy summer fruits<WH07019> and for thy harvest<WH07105> is fallen<WH05307><WTH8804>. <RF>the shouting...: or, the alarm is fallen upon, etc<Rf>

And gladness<WH08057> is taken away<WH0622><WTH8738>, and joy<WH01524> out of the plentiful field<WH03759>; and in the vineyards<WH03754> there shall be no singing<WH07442><WTH8792>, neither shall there be shouting<WH07321><WTH8783>: the treaders<WH01869><WTH8802> shall tread out<WH01869><WTH8799> no wine<WH03196> in <FI>their<Fi> presses<WH03342>; I have made <FI>their vintage<Fi> shouting<WH01959> to cease<WH07673><WTH8689>.
Wherefore my bowels<WH04578> shall sound<WH01993><WTH8799> like an harp<WH03658> for Moab<WH04124>, and mine inward parts<WH07130> for Kirharesh<WH07025>.

And it shall come to pass, when it is seen<WH07200><WTH8738> that Moab<WH04124> is weary<WH03811><WTH8738> on the high place<WH01116>, that he shall come<WH0935><WTH8804> to his sanctuary<WH04720> to pray<WH06419><WTH8692>; but he shall not prevail<WH03201><WTH8799>.
This <FI>is<Fi> the word<WH01697> that the LORD<WH03068> hath spoken<WH01696><WTH8765> concerning Moab<WH04124> since that time<WH0227>.

But now the LORD<WH03068> hath spoken<WH01696><WTH8765>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Within three<WH07969> years<WH08141>, as the years<WH08141> of an hireling<WH07916>, and the glory<WH03519> of Moab<WH04124> shall be contemned<WH07034><WTH8738>, with all that great<WH07227> multitude<WH01995>; and the remnant<WH07605> <FI>shall be<Fi> very<WH04592> small<WH04213> <FI>and<Fi> feeble<WH03808><WH03524>. <RF>feeble: or, not many<Rf><CM>
